$comment: Template placeholders supported by patterns, paths, and commands: {name}, {version}, {tag}, {target}. Hook commands also support {install_dir}, {data_home}, {config_home}, {binary_path}, and {shell}.

alias.description: Alternative names accepted by plugin lookup.

allow_insecure_no_checksum.description: Explicit opt-in for releases that ship no SHA-256 metadata at all.

asset_pattern.description: Asset filename pattern with template placeholders.

binary.description: Path to the binary within the extracted archive.

build_branch.description: Optional source ref for `--build`; accepts a branch name or tag.

build_script.description: Optional commands to build the project from source when `--build` is used.

checksum_asset_pattern.description:
Optional checksum asset filename pattern used when release metadata
does not expose an asset digest directly.

cleanup.description: Optional commands to remove user-generated data after confirmation.

description.description: Human-readable summary shown by plugin listing and info commands.

files.description:
Additional files or directory trees to install from the archive (or
source checkout when `--build` is used), beyond `binary`/`man_pages`.

man_pages.description: Paths to man pages within the extracted archive.

name.description: Primary plugin identifier used by install, update, and pin commands.

post_build.description: Optional commands to run after source builds complete.

post_install.description: Optional commands to run after installation.

post_uninstall.description: Optional commands to run after uninstalling tracked files.

signature_asset_pattern.description: Optional signature asset filename pattern for release verification.

signature_key.description: Optional key material or key identifier for signature verification.

targets.description: Map from `<os>-<arch>` key to the target triple used in release asset names.

PluginCompletions.description:
Plugin definition loaded from a TOML file.

Example plugin file (`plugins/ripgrep.toml`):
```toml
[plugin]
name = "ripgrep"
alias = ["rg", "ripgrep"]
description = "A fast line-oriented search tool"
location = "github:BurntSushi/ripgrep"
asset_pattern = "{name}-{version}-{target}.tar.gz"
binary = "{name}-{version}-{target}/rg"
man_pages = ["{name}-{version}-{target}/doc/rg.1"]

[plugin.targets]
"linux-x86_64" = "x86_64-unknown-linux-musl"
"macos-aarch64" = "aarch64-apple-darwin"
```

Template placeholders supported in `asset_pattern`, `binary`, and `man_pages`:
- `{name}`    — plugin name (e.g. "ripgrep")
- `{version}` — release version with leading `v` stripped (e.g. "14.1.0")
- `{tag}`     — release tag as returned by GitHub (e.g. "14.1.0" or "v1.2.0")
- `{target}`  — platform target triple resolved from `[plugin.targets]`

command.description:
Shell command template that prints completion script content to stdout.

Supported placeholders match hook templates plus `{shell}`.

executable.description: Force the executable bit on the installed files.

from.description:
Path inside the release archive (or the source checkout when `--build`
is used). When it names a directory, the whole tree is installed.
Supports the standard template placeholders.

to.description:
Destination path. Must start with `{install_dir}`, `{data_home}`, or
`{config_home}` followed by a relative path. Supports the standard
template placeholders.
